targetText:
Their
strategy must be one of lightning war and speedy decision. If we can hold
out for three or more years, it will be most difficult for Japan to bear
up under the strain.
explanation: Mao explains that imperialist invaders depend on quick, decisive victories because their long-distance resources are limited. Protracted resistance drains the invader's economy and military morale over time.

targetText:
guerrilla warfare conducted
in each bit of conquered territory over a wide area will be a heavy blow
struck at the Japanese bandits
explanation: By harassing enemy lines across occupied territories, guerrillas force the invading army to disperse its troops into small, vulnerable garrisons, turning the invader's territorial gains into a burden.
